duty_i18n.sl: Številka za nujne primere zvečer, ponoči, ob nedeljah in praznikih, 24 ur na dan, 7 dni v tednu; odgovori veterinar in napoti v dežurno kliniko. Plačljiva številka s povečano tarifo (CHF 2/min 8–20, CHF 5/min 20–8).
duty_i18n.hr: Hitna linija navečer, noću, nedjeljom i blagdanima, 24 h dnevno, 7 dana u tjednu; javlja se veterinar i upućuje na dežurnu kliniku. Linija s posebnom tarifom (CHF 2/min 8–20 h, CHF 5/min 20–8 h).

entries.note: MyVet emergency page 2026-11-04: '24h/24 et 7 jours/7'. Vevey clinic Arche-en-Ville page refers to a Service de la Riviera Vaudoise; official operator page not found.

entries.name: Vétéo - Cabinet Vétérinaire Montreux
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:00-12:30 and 13:15-17:30; home visits by appointment. Emergency service available at opening hours.

duty_i18n.sl: Pon–pet 8–12.30 in 13.15–17.30; obiski na domu po naročilu. Nujna pomoč je na voljo v delovnem času.
duty_i18n.hr: pon–pet 8:00–12:30 i 13:15–17:30; kućni posjeti po dogovoru. Hitna služba dostupna tijekom radnog vremena.

entries.note: Site 2026-11-04. Footer link uses +41 77 205 81 46 while visible number is 077 474 53 09. No 24h wording.

entries.name: Cabinet vétérinaire Le Trèfle
entries.duty: Small-animal practice north of Nyon (Petite Prairie district). Call for hours.

duty_i18n.sl: Ordinacija za male hišne ljubljenčke severno od Nyona (četrt Petite Prairie). Za delovni čas pokličite.
duty_i18n.hr: Ambulanta za male životinje sjeverno od Nyona (četvrt Petite Prairie). Za radno vrijeme nazovi.

entries.note: Home page 2026-11-04: phone and district only; no street address, hours or emergency info on the page.

entries.name: VetUrgences (VetSpecialistes) Grand-Saconnex
entries.duty: Emergency centre open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and public holidays.

duty_i18n.sl: Center za nujno pomoč je odprt 24 ur na dan, 7 dni v tednu, tudi ob koncih tedna in praznikih.
duty_i18n.hr: Centar za hitne slučajeve radi 24 sata dnevno, 7 dana u tjednu, uključujući vikende i blagdane.

entries.note: Page 2026-11-04: '24h/24 et 7j/7', '365 jours par an'; associated with VetSpecialistes referral centre. Page is a Nyon-targeted landing page of the Geneva centre; main site not separately opened.

entries.name: Anima Tierärzte-Team AG (Thayngen)
entries.duty: Evenings and weekends: Schaffhausen emergency ring 0900 900 109 (premium rate) for small animals.

duty_i18n.sl: Zvečer in ob koncih tedna: schaffhausenska nujna služba 0900 900 109 (plačljiva številka s povečano tarifo) za male hišne ljubljenčke.
duty_i18n.hr: Navečer i vikendom: hitna služba Schaffhausen 0900 900 109 (linija s posebnom tarifom) za male životinje.

entries.name: VetTrust Zentrum für Tiermedizin Klettgau
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:30-13:00 and 14:30-19:00, Sat 9:00-13:00, Sun closed. Member of the Schaffhausen emergency ring (0900 900 109).

duty_i18n.sl: Pon–pet 8.30–13 in 14.30–19, sob 9–13, ned zaprto. Članica schaffhauške nujne službe (0900 900 109).
duty_i18n.hr: pon–pet 8:30–13:00 i 14:30–19:00, sub 9:00–13:00, ned zatvoreno. Član hitne službe Schaffhausen (0900 900 109).

entries.name: VetTrust Notfalltelefon (Deutschschweiz)
entries.duty: VetTrust emergency line, around the clock, 7 days a week; callers are routed by postcode to the nearest VetTrust location on duty.

duty_i18n.sl: Številka za nujne primere VetTrust, 24 ur na dan, 7 dni v tednu; klicatelje glede na poštno številko preusmerijo na najbližjo dežurno lokacijo VetTrust.
duty_i18n.hr: Hitna linija VetTrust, non-stop, 7 dana u tjednu; pozivi se prema poštanskom broju usmjeravaju na najbližu dežurnu lokaciju VetTrust.

entries.duty: Call the practice for hours and emergencies.

entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:00-12:00 and 13:30-18:00, Sat 9:00-12:00. Emergency service for clients also outside opening hours.

duty_i18n.sl: Pon–pet 8–12 in 13.30–18, sob 9–12. Nujna pomoč za stranke tudi izven delovnega časa.
